properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 5 at 4:26PM MDT until August 5 at 4:45PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 426 PM MDT, a severe thunderstorm was located over San Luis, or 30
miles southeast of San Luis Valley Airport, moving east at 15 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
San Luis and Chama.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 5 at 4:24PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 424 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 16
miles southwest of Kim, or 27 miles northeast of Des Moines, moving
east at 10 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph, half inch hail and brief heavy
rain.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

This storm will remain over mainly rural areas of southeastern Las
Animas County.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 5 at 4:18PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
